title: Set up your workspace
description: Connect the services you choose, review privacy, and check what data is ready.
ai.title: Choose AI and privacy settings
ai.text: Connect an AI model in Settings › Models. You can change which services can use your data there at any time. You can keep local data access without configuring a remote model.
capability.title: Check model capability
capability.text: A capability probe sends a request to the saved remote model. It runs only when you choose Probe saved model in AI settings.
sourcesText: Connect a source or upload personal data from the existing Data sources workspace. Collection and indexing progress are shown there.
samplesTitle: Choose sample data or personal import
samplesText: Sample data adds fictional examples; personal imports use the Data sources workspace. Choose one to continue.
indexingText: Lexical search uses retained indexed text and remains available without a remote model. Semantic search and remote-dependent chat require their configured provider capabilities.
completeText: You can return to these steps at any time from the user menu. Existing sources and conversations remain available if a remote provider is unavailable.
saveFailed: Could not save onboarding progress. Your current step is unchanged.
offline: The server is unavailable. Browser offline access is not provided.
providerUnavailable: The server is reachable, but the remote provider capability is unavailable. Retained data and lexical search remain available.
ai.ready: Remote AI is configured and reasoning is permitted.
ai.needsSetup: Remote AI isn't set up yet.
capability.ready: The saved chat model has a supported capability result.
capability.needsProbe: Chat capability has not been verified. Use the explicit saved-model probe in AI settings.
source.unknown: Could not load sources; the server or source service may be unavailable.
semantic.unavailable: Semantic search is currently unavailable for this configuration or index.
semantic.compatibilityHelp: The available status does not include the model version and gateway identity required to confirm semantic search compatibility.
lexicalIndependent: Lexical search uses retained document text independently of embedding index status when the server is reachable.
topics.title: Topics to follow
topics.text: Optional. Pick topics to personalize your news; you can change them any time in news settings. You can skip and continue.
topics.saveFailed: Could not update the topic. Try again.
personalSourcesNote: Personal sources (mail, calendar, drive) are optional and connected one at a time in Data sources.
